# Manual Approval and Amendment Requirements

Document: Information Technology Office Procedure Manual
Edition: 6th Edition
Effective date: 21 NOV 2024
Retrieval group ID: SEC-1.2
Group type: Governance
Chapter: 1
Section: 1.2

System(s) or asset(s): IT OPM
Responsible role(s): Head of Information Technology Department, IT Section Manager / IT Manager, All IT Personnel, Information Technology Services Staff, Bandar Najdi Manager IT D

## Arabic Search Terms

## Records

- Edition Approval Basis [REC-009; Approval Statement]
  The edition was approved after the review update and approval process of the documented procedure Control of SA Documents
  Reference or recipient: Control of SA Documents

- Major Manual Revision [REC-010; Approval Requirement]
  The Head of the Information Technology Department shall obtain Managing Director approval before a major manual revision
  Responsible role: Head of Information Technology Department | Trigger or condition: Before a major manual revision | Evidence or record: Approval | Reference or recipient: Managing Director

- Financial Changes [REC-011; Approval Requirement]
  The Head of the Information Technology Department shall obtain Managing Director approval before financial changes
  Responsible role: Head of Information Technology Department | Trigger or condition: Before financial changes | Evidence or record: Approval | Reference or recipient: Managing Director

- Recruitment Changes [REC-012; Approval Requirement]
  The Head of the Information Technology Department shall obtain Managing Director approval before recruitment changes
  Responsible role: Head of Information Technology Department | Trigger or condition: Before recruitment changes | Evidence or record: Approval | Reference or recipient: Managing Director

- Minor Amendments [REC-013; Approval Requirement]
  All minor amendments shall be approved by the IT Section Manager or IT Manager
  Responsible role: IT Section Manager / IT Manager | Trigger or condition: For minor amendments | Evidence or record: Approval

- Manual Familiarity [REC-014; Personnel Requirement]
  All IT personnel must be familiar with the use compliance and implementation of the IT OPM
  Responsible role: All IT Personnel | System or asset: IT OPM | Frequency or timing: Ongoing

- Keep Manual Current [REC-015; Recommendation]
  Information Technology Services staff are strongly recommended to keep the IT OPM current and up to date
  Responsible role: Information Technology Services Staff | System or asset: IT OPM | Frequency or timing: Ongoing

- Submit Suggestions [REC-016; Recommendation]
  Information Technology Services staff are strongly recommended to submit suggestions in writing to the concerned managers
  Responsible role: Information Technology Services Staff | Evidence or record: Written Suggestion | Reference or recipient: Concerned Managers

- Prepared By [REC-017; Approval Record]
  Prepared by Bandar Najdi Manager IT D on 20 NOV 2024

  A KPI is a metric or measure used to quantify and evaluate organizational and achievement success

- KPI Uses [REC-065; KPI Purpose]
  KPIs are used to set measurable objectives evaluate progress monitor trends make improvements and support decision making

- Management Alert [REC-066; KPI Requirement]
  A KPI measurement shall alert management if there are impending problems in a Key Performance Area
  Responsible role: Management | Trigger or condition: Impending problems in a Key Performance Area

a. Specific Measurement Data [REC-067; KPI Component]
  The indicator consists of specific measurement data
  Parent record: REC-066

b. Predetermined Standard [REC-068; KPI Component]
  The indicator consists of a predetermined standard against which the data will be compared
  Parent record: REC-066

- Average Response Time to Support Tickets [REC-069; KPI]
  Average response time to support tickets shall be within two working days of ticket creation
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk Support Tickets | Frequency or timing: Measured from ticket creation | Target or threshold: Within 2 working days | Evidence or record: KPI Records / Support Ticket Timestamps

- IT Ticket Closure Rate [REC-070; KPI]
  Maintain a minimum closure rate of 97 percent for IT tickets per year
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: IT Tickets | Frequency or timing: Per year | Target or threshold: Minimum 97 percent | Evidence or record: KPI Records

- Failure to Meet KPI Goals [REC-071; Corrective Action Requirement]
  Failure to meet established KPI goals will be addressed by starting problem solving and an appropriate improvement method
  Trigger or condition: When an established KPI goal is not met | Evidence or record: Problem Solving / Improvement Record

## Records

  When any stated system fails the listed steps shall be followed to ensure business continuity
  System or asset: Freshdesk / TMS / EDRAK | Trigger or condition: Failure in an above-mentioned system

1. Troubleshoot the Problem [REC-106; Business Continuity Step]
  Troubleshoot the problem
  System or asset: Affected System | Frequency or timing: As soon as possible | Trigger or condition: System failure | Parent record: REC-105

2. Apply Needed Fix [REC-107; Business Continuity Step]
  Apply the needed fix as soon as possible
  System or asset: Affected System | Frequency or timing: As soon as possible | Trigger or condition: System failure | Parent record: REC-105

3. Contact Vendor [REC-108; Business Continuity Step]
  Contact the vendor if needed
  Frequency or timing: When vendor support is needed | Reference or recipient: System Vendor | Parent record: REC-105

4. Switch to EDRAK Backup Server [REC-109; Business Continuity Step]
  For EDRAK switch immediately to the backup server if troubleshooting takes more than one day

structured_steps.title: Stations Powered On
structured_steps.what: Make sure all stations are on

structured_steps.title: Peripheral Connection and Condition
structured_steps.what: Make sure the headset mouse and keyboard are connected and nothing is broken

structured_steps.title: EDRAK Software Running
structured_steps.what: Make sure EDRAK software is running on all stations

structured_steps.title: Server Error Messages
structured_steps.what: Check whether there are error messages on the EDRAK servers

structured_steps.title: Server and Switch Indicators
structured_steps.what: Confirm that all indicator lights on all switches and servers are green and that there are no red lights
structured_steps.target: All green and no red light

structured_steps.title: Server Cabinet Fans
structured_steps.what: Make sure all server cabinet fans are operating properly and are clean

structured_steps.title: Room Temperature and Airflow
structured_steps.what: Make sure the room temperature is between 18 and 24 degrees Celsius and that air-conditioning flow is acceptable

structured_steps.title: Room Cleanliness and Cable Security
structured_steps.what: Make sure the Communication Room is clean free of dust and debris tidy and that all wires are secured

structured_steps.title: EDRAK Data Backup
structured_steps.what: Conduct an EDRAK data backup

structured_steps.title: Log in to SQL Virtual Machine
structured_steps.what: Log in to the SQL virtual machine from the H1 server

structured_steps.title: Open Backup Scripts
structured_steps.what: Open the two backup scripts in C drive using MSSQL

structured_steps.title: Update Backup File Date
structured_steps.what: Change the file name in the script to today's date

structured_steps.title: Run Backup Script
structured_steps.what: Run the backup script

structured_steps.title: Copy to H3 SQL Virtual Machine
structured_steps.what: Copy the backup files to the H3 SQL virtual machine

structured_steps.title: Copy to External Hard Drive
structured_steps.what: Copy the backup files to the external hard drive

structured_steps.title: Interrupted or Incomplete Routine Task
structured_steps.what: When a routine task is interrupted or cannot be completed within its timeframe an appropriate comment shall be written in the remark field of the routine maintenance card
